═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ARTICLE I - DEFINITIONS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

"Consolidated EBITDA" means, for any period, net income plus:
(a) interest expense;
(b) income tax expense;
(c) depreciation and amortization.

This is a conservative EBITDA definition with only standard adjustments.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ARTICLE VII - NEGATIVE COVENANTS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Section 7.05. Asset Sales.

Permitted only with lender consent or in ordinary course of business.
100% of net proceeds shall be applied to mandatory prepayment of Term Loans.

Section 7.08. Investments.

No investments in Unrestricted Subsidiaries permitted without unanimous lender consent.
